warning_source: Egyptian government/intelligence — exact issuing unit/person not public
warning_summary: Egypt warned in a document delivered to the prime minister that funds from Qatar, Turkey and Iran were being transferred directly to Hamas's military wing rather than only for civilian purposes.
evidence_update: Yedioth/Ynet 19 Sep 2026 investigation, based on internal intelligence documents and senior-official testimony, reports the 2018 Egyptian document and direct PM delivery; Times of Israel independently summarized the finding while preserving PMO and Qatar denials. Published to Notion as WARN-124 / Medium confidence / Retrospective / Strongly documented receipt.
gaps: Underlying Egyptian document, exact 2018 date and issuing body remain unpublished. No document-specific Israeli response is public. PMO rejects the investigation and says security chiefs supported the humanitarian grant; Qatar denies funding Hamas. Not an imminent-attack forecast.

warning_summary: Warning roughly three days before Oct. 7 that a major escalation or event like the coming attack could occur.
evidence_update: McCaul's post-classified-briefing statement and contemporaneous reporting were rechecked. He confirmed that Egypt warned Israel but explicitly said the recipient level was unclear. No public Egyptian/Israeli primary record identifying the recipient surfaced.
gaps: Need named qualifying recipient and primary/authoritative warning record. Preserve PMO/direct-Netanyahu denial and the U.S. briefing-participant account that the warning was low-grade/non-concrete.

recipient: Israeli Foreign Ministry and National Security Council
warning_summary: Later reporting says Egyptian officials warned Gaza was explosive and could blow up, with a separate focused warning that something big was coming.
evidence_update: Lane 3 re-audit found no new documentary or named-witness evidence sufficient to overcome the Foreign Ministry and NSC denials.
gaps: Need meeting records, named witnesses, primary Egyptian record or authoritative inquiry evidence.

warning_summary: Reported warning that Qatari Gaza funds were reaching Hamas's military wing.
evidence_update: Yedioth/Ynet 19 Sep 2026 says internal MI documents from Feb 2019 onward repeatedly recorded Hamas government-to-military-wing transfers and assessed the Qatari grant as a source; State Comptroller testimony and intelligence-source reporting strengthen the broader premise. WARN-31 Notion body upgraded; classification remains Medium.
gaps: Original Argaman letter remains unpublished; PMO dispute over attribution to the Qatari grant remains.

warning_summary: Warning that Hamas was diverting roughly $4 million from civilian resources to its military wing.
evidence_update: Yedioth/Ynet 19 Sep 2026 reports State Comptroller testimony quantifying roughly $4m/month diversion during 2019-21 and another MI assessment around 40% of the military wing budget; separate covert Qatar-related funding channel also reported. WARN-32 Notion body upgraded; remains High / Partially acted.
gaps: PMO still disputes that the acknowledged $4m diversion came from the Qatari stipend itself.
